publicMilestone.title: Deployed bridge code, authority and policy pin observer
publicMilestone.detail: 12 local +2 worker guards;5 actual private-copy checks. Both deployed V2 programmes match reviewed artifact, full ProgramData, upgrade authority and static committee/epoch/pause/cap policy. Wrong code/authority/policy pins reject against real accounts. Two finalized snapshots per side; zero signing/simulations/broadcasts, originals unchanged and copies stopped. Separate observer; signer integration and independent verification remain open.
